web.title: Overtime pay - Fair Work Ombudsman
web.description:
# Overtime pay
Overtime is work performed outside the ordinary hours listed in an award or agreement.

## Time off instead of overtime pay
Some awards and registered agreements allow an employee to take paid time off instead of being paid overtime pay.
